units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 1:8">Tosef. Shebi. I, 8</cite> <he>לא יקנח … מפני שמַתְרִיפוֹ</he> ed. Zuck. (oth. ed. <he>שמתרין</he>, <he>שמתרן</he>) (in the Sabbatical year) one must not smear resin over a root (of a bulbous plant), because it makes it softer (advances its ripening).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 19b:12">B. Bath. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>בשהִתְרִיפוּ</he> when the dates are rotten.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 5:7:6">Y. B. Kam. V, end, 5ᵃ</cite> <he>בשהתריפו מחמת אוירו</he> when the animals grew sick from the air in the pit (v. <cite ref="E00042"><he>הֶבֶל</he></cite>).
